title: Learning the Anyon Atlas
abstract: arXiv:2611.24752v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We extend our previous search for the modular data of topological quantum field theories in 2+1 dimensions from 22 to 42 anyons, identifying 150,679 new modular data. We do so by adding to our algorithm three rejection gates, two of them based on logistic regression, that discard representations of $SL(2,\mathbb{Z})$ unlikely to yield modular data. We estimate that roughly 80% of the modular data between ranks 23 and 42 has been identified after closing under known constructions. With this data, we find counterexamples to a conjecture of Geiko and Moore that the reality of the higher Gauss sums suffices for time-reversal symmetry in Chern-Simons theories, and propose a refined criterion. We demonstrate the scalability of this gated implementation by identifying prime modular data at rank 100 that is not realized by any Chern-Simons theory. translated_abstract: 我们将之前对2+1维拓扑量子场论模数据的搜索从22个任意子扩展到42个任意子，识别出150,679个新的模数据。为此，我们在算法中增加了三个拒绝门（其中两个基于逻辑回归），用于舍弃不太可能产生模数据的SL(2,Z)表示。我们估计，在经过已知构造的闭包处理后，秩23到42之间的模数据大约已有80%被识别。利用这些数据，我们找到了Geiko和Moore猜想（即高阶高斯和的实性足以保证陈-西蒙斯理论中的时间反演对称性）的反例，并提出了一个改进的判据。我们通过识别秩100处未被任何陈-西蒙斯理论实现的本原模数据，展示了这种门控实现的可扩展性。秩42以内已识别的数据已在https://AnyonAtlas.org上发布。
tldr: 通过引入基于逻辑回归的拒绝门算法，将2+1维拓扑量子场论模数据的搜索从22个任意子扩展至42个，识别出150,679个新模数据，据此推翻了Geiko-Moore关于高斯和实性足以保证时间反演对称性的猜想，并展示了算法在秩100处的可扩展性。
en_tdlr: By adding logistic-regression-based rejection gates to their search algorithm, the authors extend the catalog of modular data for 2+1D topological quantum field theories from 22 to 42 anyons, identifying 150,679 new datasets that yield counterexamples to the Geiko-Moore conjecture on time-reversal symmetry and demonstrate scalability by finding prime modular data at rank 100 unrealizable by any Chern-Simons theory.
